headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets pulled off a thrilling 10-9 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Drake Baldwin leading the Mets' offense. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 win over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe hitting a home run and driving in three runs. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, with Nick Lodolo pitching 6.0 strong innings.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Max Rajcic, a right-handed pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. Martín Pérez, a left-handed pitcher for the Atlanta Braves, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left forearm contusion. Other injured players include Brandon Woodruff (Milwaukee Brewers), Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies), Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies), Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants), Ha-Seong Kim (Atlanta Braves), and Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The New York Mets acquired Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Pull Off Thrilling 10-9 Victory Over Braves**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a high-scoring matchup, winning 10-9. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit a home run and drove in three runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2 in a closely contested game. Nick Lodolo led the Reds to victory with a strong 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. Ryan earned the win with 9 strikeouts and no earned runs allowed.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer Historic Loss to Royals**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies were defeated by the Kansas City Royals with a final score of 15-1. The Royals' offense was led by multiple impact hitters, including Bobby Witt Jr. and Salvador Perez.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. The move is retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash consideration.
